title: Wake
desc_lfm_album: Wake is the 2014 2nd album of Post-Hardcore/Progressive California-Based rock band Hail The Sun. The band provides a very impressive follow up effort with passionate vocals courtesy of Donovan Melero along with thoughtful, well written lyrics with an energetic and dynamic performance from the rest of the band. .
desc_lfm_artist:
Hail The Sun are a post-hardcore band from Chico, California, United States.

Hail The Sun formed with four friends who have been playing together for over a decade. The sound they formed has a seductive touch, that invites one's ears to come along. Each band member brings their own style to the party, which forms a chemistry that is much more than a compound. Influences include only life, and modern mishaps and rendezvous. Musically and lyrically these guys go at it more than rabbits, more and more defining a unique sound.
